title: Accounts Receivable Note: Payments, Returned Payments and Refunds on Respite and Short-Term Stays
content:
Payments on a stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement are posted once per instrument. A long-term care insurer may pay a stay directly when the guest assigns benefits.

## Returned payments

A returned payment is reinstated referencing the payment entry returned. Each payment entry is reinstated by one returned-payment entry at most: a payment entry that the stay's ledger already shows as returned is not reinstated a second time.

## Refund of a credit balance

A credit balance on a stay is refunded to the party who paid it no later than the refund period of the stay type after check-out or cancellation, in one refund per stay balance. A refund may be issued only while the stay is in completed, cancelled or converted status; a credit balance during a stay is applied to later nights instead. The status read is the one on the stay record.

| Stay status on record | Credit balance |
|---|---|
| Booked | No refund issued |
| In stay | No refund issued; applied to later nights |
| Completed | Refunded to the party who paid it, within the refund period after check-out |
| Cancelled | Refunded to the party who paid it, within the refund period after cancellation |
| Converted | Refunded to the party who paid it |

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical stay is cancelled with a credit balance of 1,200.00, all of it paid by the guest's son. The credit balance is refunded to the son in one refund of 1,200.00, issued no later than the refund period after the cancellation. Had the same 1,200.00 credit stood while the guest was still in stay, no refund would issue and the credit would be applied to later nights.
